answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI agent to reserve 1,000 units to secure a unique operational slot, acting like a rare pearl held in a vault. A verifier monitors the ledger to ensure no agent double-commits identity slots at any terrace of the network. While an honest agent pays 1,000 units, an attacker deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 unit penalty. Any glacier of evidence showing identity overlap triggers a mandatory 180-day forfeiture of all locked funds, ensuring nodes remain uniquely accountable.
